gates.enables: Metadata-only policy approval with runtime disabled.
gates.still_forbids: Live calls, source probes, source-cache writes, evidence writes, index mutation, downloads, uploads, public fanout.
gates.rollback_or_kill_switch: No runtime enabled; policy can be reverted by ordinary commit.

gates.enables: Fixture replay hardening for metadata search, item metadata, file-list metadata, 429/Retry-After, missing, malformed, and no-download cases.
gates.still_forbids: Live calls, source-cache writes, evidence writes, index mutation, downloads, public fanout.
gates.rollback_or_kill_switch: Fixtures remain repo-local; no runtime live switch exists.

gates.enables: One-shot approved local live metadata probe after IA-01 and explicit operator approval.
gates.still_forbids: Downloads, uploads, write APIs, public fanout, source-cache writes by default, evidence writes, index mutation.
gates.rollback_or_kill_switch: Kill switch checked before every future live call; disabled state fails closed.

gates.enables: Source cache write path for approved metadata observations only.
gates.still_forbids: Evidence acceptance, candidate/reviewed/master index mutation, downloads, public fanout.
gates.rollback_or_kill_switch: Cache reset command and kill switch stop new writes.

gates.enables: Evidence candidate generation from cached IA metadata source observations.
gates.still_forbids: Accepted truth without review, reviewed index mutation, master index mutation, downloads.
gates.rollback_or_kill_switch: Disable evidence candidate worker and clear generated candidates by task-approved reset.

gates.enables: Candidate index integration for reviewed candidate proposals.
gates.still_forbids: Reviewed local index mutation without review dry-run, master index mutation, public fanout.
gates.rollback_or_kill_switch: Disable candidate integration and rebuild candidate fixture state.

gates.still_forbids: Automatic acceptance, master index mutation, production/public claims.
gates.rollback_or_kill_switch: Dry-run only; no reviewed index write.

gates.enables: Reviewed local index rebuild only after review/promotion proof.
gates.still_forbids: Master index mutation, public launch claims, downloads/uploads, public fanout unless separately approved.
gates.rollback_or_kill_switch: Rebuild can be reverted to previous reviewed local index snapshot.
